lines.text: नमस्ते। आज हम grid code compliance testing के basic steps देखेंगे।
lines.en: Hello. Today we will look at the basic steps of grid code compliance testing.

lines.text: पहला step: test plan बनाइए और उसे transmission utility से approve करवाइए।
lines.en: First step: prepare the test plan and get it approved by the transmission utility.

lines.text: दूसरा: measurement equipment की calibration certificate रखिए।
lines.en: Second: keep the calibration certificate of the measurement equipment.

lines.text: फिर power quality, reactive power और ride-through tests होते हैं।
lines.en: Then come the power quality, reactive power and ride-through tests.

lines.text: हर test के लिए उस दिन की grid condition record कीजिए।
lines.en: For every test, record that day's grid conditions.

lines.text: Report में raw data और plots दोनों चाहिए, सिर्फ़ summary नहीं।
lines.en: The report needs both raw data and plots, not just a summary.

tldr: Compliance testing follows an approved plan with calibrated equipment.
Reports need raw data and plots for each test.

flashcards.front: What must the test report include?
flashcards.back: Raw data and plots for every test, not just a summary.
